description: This file defines API endpoints for browsing and retrieving details of videos in a streaming platform. It uses FastAPI framework with Pydantic models for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a video entity with attributes like id, title, description, genre, release year, thumbnail, and duration.

methods.name: list_videos( q: str = Query("", description="Search query"), genre: str = Query(None, description="Filter by genre"), skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20 )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to browse or search videos with optional filters like genre, limit, and query string.

methods.name: get_video(video_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to retrieve metadata for a specific video by its ID.
